steps.title: How did document review change?
steps.description: Ana submits the same batch in both designs. Follow the classic job through the API, queue and review worker. The later platform also accepts uploads through a file processor and streams interactive drafts through an assistant API. The execution paths share model access and persist review outcomes. Batch review applied the assignment rubric and drafted feedback in a common style. In guided review, Ana can ask for encouragement with emojis, while another teacher can ask for direct comments without them. The cost tables compare five monthly active-user volumes, assuming ten reviews per person. Follow the fixed Redis and compute costs at low volume, then compare worker capacity and model calls as usage grows.
